description: Relative turnover and trading-activity proxies computed from historical base volume and prices.

definitions.V: base traded volume in a closed bar
definitions.R: close / previous close - 1 within a continuous timestamp segment
definitions.turnover_relative_volume_W: V[t] / mean(V[t-W:t]); the baseline excludes the current bar
definitions.turnover_relative_daily_W: sum(V[t-5:t+1]) / (6 * mean(V[t-5-W:t-5])); disjoint 24h and baseline windows
definitions.turnover_volume_cv_W: sample_std(V over last W bars, ddof=1) / mean(V over last W bars)
definitions.turnover_volume_maxshare_W: max(V over last W bars) / sum(V over last W bars)
definitions.turnover_directional_W: sum(sign(R) * V over last W bars) / sum(V over last W bars)
definitions.turnover_price_corr_W: Pearson correlation(V, R) over last W bars
definitions.turnover_return_premium_W: sum(V * R) / sum(V) - mean(R), over last W bars

missing_values: Require complete windows, restart after gaps, and return null for zero denominators or undefined correlations.
